task.question: What was the number of participants in the anti-war protest in Japan in April 2026?
task.evidence: April 8 – Thirty thousand people participate in an anti-war and anti-constitutional amendment protest in front of the National Diet Building in Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo. Similar protests are also held in 150 other places across Japan.

answer:
Based on the search results, I found information about anti-war protests in Japan in April 2026. According to the sources:

- On April 19, 2026, approximately **36,000 participants** gathered outside the National Diet (parliament)
- On April 8, 2026, anti-war demonstrations were held across more than 100 locations drawing nearly **50,000 people** according to organizers

The most prominent single location figure mentioned is the April 19 protest outside the National Diet with approximately 36,000 participants.

FINAL: 36,000
